0022600018.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, coming off a loss) host the New York Knicks (1-3), who are 12th in the East while the 76ers are 4th. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle, sprain). The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 106-100 win in New York on October 20, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26 before Philadelphia lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
